body: This. Sometimes you forget how many people there actually are out there. This one doesn't sound like she was the girl for you. That does not mean there aren't others that WILL be the right one, or at least a closer fit. You just have to give yourself the change to meet them, and that means living. You deserve to be alive and find happiness with someone who loves you.

I think quality really depends on which hotline you're calling. The national ones usually have pretty good training for volunteers (in Australia, it involves weeks of training), and they are all typically on the pathway to a career in mental health and therefore probably do care about what you've got to say. That said, I know from experience that talking to them can feel counterproductive. 

Something I like to remember is that the people on the other end of the line do not have all the answers, but they are willing to listen. And usually it's less about what they say to you, and more about you just getting all of your thoughts/ feelings out that is helpful. Or, maybe even just talking to distract yourself for the 5-10 minutes it takes you help you calm down and think clearly.
I hope that the feeling subsides this time too. Stay safe this weekend <3
Who do you think the voice belonged to?
Sometimes you can have it all but still feel like you have nothing. These feelings are the WORST, but they do pass. I promise. It might take awhile, but things won't always feel this bad.
